style: 2D side-view game art in the style of Hollow Knight: hand-drawn, crisp dark ink outlines, muted desaturated palette with deep navy and teal shadows, subtle painterly texture, readable silhouettes.
sprite_bg: Isolated on a plain solid flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) background that fills the entire image. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no border, no cast shadow, no glow or particles on the background. Keep every object well separated from the others and from the image edges.

assets.name: player
assets.prompt: Character sprite sheet, 4 columns x 2 rows of equally spaced cells, the SAME character in every cell with identical proportions, colors and scale, all facing RIGHT, side view, feet on the same baseline. Character: a small hooded archer named Wren: pale white oval mask face with two large black eyes, dark navy ragged cloak to the knees, thin dark legs, long crimson scarf. Hands tucked inside the cloak, NO bow. Row 1: (1) idle standing, (2) run: right leg stretched forward, left leg back, (3) run: legs passing under the body, left foot lifted, (4) run: left leg stretched forward, right leg back. Row 2: (5) run: legs passing, right foot lifted, (6) jump rising with knees tucked and cloak trailing down, (7) falling with cloak and scarf flaring upward, (8) dash: body leaning hard forward, cloak and scarf streaming straight back.

assets.name: bow
assets.prompt: A single elegant recurve longbow made of dark carved wood with pale bone tips and a wrapped leather grip, shown vertically (tips at top and bottom, curving to the right), WITHOUT a bowstring, centered.

assets.name: arrows
assets.prompt: Six different magical arrows stacked vertically in one column, each arrow horizontal and pointing RIGHT, same length, evenly spaced. From top to bottom: (1) Steel arrow: plain dark wood shaft, grey steel broadhead, white feathers. (2) Lift arrow: shaft with a glowing teal crystal head and small stone wing fins. (3) Tether arrow: a brass grappling-hook head with a coil of rope wrapped on the shaft. (4) Ember arrow: head wreathed in orange flame, red feathers. (5) Frost arrow: pale blue ice-crystal head, frosted shaft, white feathers. (6) Blink arrow: violet void-crystal head with a purple shimmer, black feathers.
